name: Spotless: Clean Phone & Photos
tagline: Free up storage by finding duplicate photos, large videos and old clutter — all on your iPhone.
storage_summary: Your photos, videos, contacts and calendar are analysed on your device and never uploaded. Scan results and settings are stored only on your device.

firebase.name: Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics)
firebase.purpose: Tells us which features are used and reports crashes. Never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
firebase.data: in-app usage events, device model, OS version, app version, language, coarse region, an app-generated instance identifier and crash logs

apple_geocoding.name: Apple (Maps geocoding)
apple_geocoding.purpose: Turns the GPS coordinates stored in your photos into a readable place name for the place-based albums.
apple_geocoding.data: the latitude and longitude of photos shown in place-based albums — never the photos themselves

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare (speed test)
cloudflare.purpose: Measures your connection speed when you run the optional Wi-Fi speed test.
cloudflare.data: meaningless filler data transferred to and from Cloudflare's public speed-test endpoint, plus your IP address as part of any internet connection

data_sent.what: Usage events, device model, OS version, app identifiers
data_sent.why: Understand usage and improve the app

data_sent.what: GPS coordinates of photos, only when you open the place-based albums
data_sent.why: Show a place name for each album

data_sent.what: Filler test data, only while you run the Wi-Fi speed test

stored_on_device: Scan results for duplicates, similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and large videos. The photos and videos themselves are analysed on your device and never leave it.
Contact and calendar cleanup results, including the undo history for merged contacts.
Your settings, reminders and cleanup statistics.
Items you delete go to iOS's **Recently Deleted** album, where iOS keeps them for 30 days.
not_collected: Your photos, videos, files, contacts or calendar events — none of them are uploaded.
Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), precise location of your device, microphone or camera.

permissions.name: Photos
permissions.why: to scan your library on your device for duplicates, similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and large videos, to delete the items you choose, and to save new images such as a still made from a Live Photo.

permissions.name: Contacts (optional)
permissions.why: only if you use the contact cleanup tool, to find and merge duplicates on your device.

permissions.name: Calendars (optional)
permissions.why: only if you use calendar cleanup, to find old past events on your device and remove the ones you confirm.

permissions.name: Notifications (optional)
permissions.why: for reminders you turn on, such as cleanup reports and charging reminders.

your_controls: **Revoke Photos, Contacts, Calendars or Notifications access** in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security.
**Recover deleted photos** from the Recently Deleted album in the Photos app within 30 days.
**Delete all app data** by deleting the app. Nothing is stored on our side.

subscription.restore_location: on the Premium screen, or in Settings → Restore Purchases

support_faq.q: I deleted a photo by mistake.
support_faq.a: Open the **Photos** app → **Albums** → **Recently Deleted**. iOS keeps deleted items there for 30 days.

support_faq.q: The app finds no photos or only some of them.
support_faq.a: Open iOS **Settings → Privacy & Security → Photos → Spotless** and choose **Full Access**. With limited access the app can only scan the photos you selected.
No. Every scan runs on your iPhone. Photos, videos, contacts and calendar events never leave your device.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Delete the app. Your data lives only on your device, so this removes it completely.
